properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (inference.rs inference_walk_full; propagate.rs BlastRadius.objections_returning). Each row carries `conclusion_was` (holds, conditional, contested, unsupported, refuted), `conclusion_reads` may be `contested`, and `untouched_routes` names the claim's other steps the change never reaches, whatever they read. A claim that was only contested and is left with nothing is carried on like one that fell. An objection a lost reply had answered is listed in `objections_returning` with what it attacks, and those targets are reached in turn.
properties.name: A what-if says what a contested claim loses, names the routes it never reaches, and names each objection that comes back
